title: The protein corona at the nano-bio interface: the need for standardized methodology and opportunities for neurodegenerative disease intervention
content:

This review analyzes the protein corona at the nano-bio interface and proposes a standardized methodological framework. We explore how nanoparticles can accelerate or inhibit neurodegenerative pathology, turning the PC into a functional tool.
